headline: Goa Plans Direct Atal Setu Access for Porvorim Residents
summary: The Goa government is planning direct entry to the Atal Setu bridge for Porvorim residents to improve local connectivity. Authorities also intend to reopen the old route to ease traffic congestion.

summary: Following the launch of the Porvorim corridor, the state government is planning to build new access ramps. Goa is seeking financial assistance from the Centre to execute the project.

summary: Artificial intelligence technology is being leveraged to boost the presence and development of the Konkani language. Digital initiatives aim to assist in wider integration and preservation.

summary: The state government has reduced Value Added Tax on Aviation Turbine Fuel from 15% to 7%, effective October 24. The policy decision aims to encourage more flights and potentially lower airfares.

summary: Goa has cut VAT on aviation turbine fuel to 7% starting October 24. The move is expected to support airlines and increase air travel accessibility to the region.
